ops.title: Review 6ce123cb: probe changes shell override semantics
ops.body:
FAIL — 1 major issue.

Reviewed commit `6ce123cb882596f81617abe77ed51525ba747e66` against `33a170149458ff8b6cfcd90ae28f7048a0e856bc` in `/Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/orca/xmr-probe`.

**major — src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/claude-help-flag-probe.ts:40**

The resolver shares command text with resume, but direct execution changes its shell semantics. With the supported override `~/bin/claude`, the resume shell expands the path and launches successfully; the probe instead executes the literal path, gets `ENOENT`, and caches `false`. A PowerShell override such as `& 'C:\Program Files\Claude\claude.exe'` similarly becomes executable `&`. Recovery then omits `--append-system-prompt` and its context (`src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-resume.ts:45`). Existing launch tests explicitly support these command forms (`src/shared/agent-resume-launch-command.test.ts:346` and `:494`); the E2E helper also emits the PowerShell form (`tests/e2e/helpers/fake-agent-command-override.ts:20`).

Fix: retain the shared base resolver and execute the help command with resume's effective shell semantics, reusing shell selection and command-building helpers. Add probe/launch parity tests for tilde paths, environment expansion, and PowerShell's call operator and quoted paths. Do not repair these with separate ad hoc string replacements.

Validation:

- `ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1 mise exec node@24.21.0 pnpm@12.0.0 -- pnpm tc` exited 0. Output: `/tmp/xmr-probe-review-tc.log`.
- `ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1 mise exec node@24.21.0 pnpm@12.0.0 -- pnpm test src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/claude-help-flag-probe.test.ts src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-launch.test.ts`: 2 files, 14 tests passed. Output: `/tmp/xmr-probe-review-tests.log`.
- `ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1 mise exec node@24.21.0 pnpm@12.0.0 -- pnpm test src/shared/agent-resume-launch-command.test.ts src/shared/tui-agent-startup.test.ts src/shared/commit-message-plan.test.ts src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-resume.test.ts`: 4 files, 210 tests passed. Output: `/tmp/xmr-probe-review-related-tests.log`.
- `node /tmp/xmr-probe-review-repro.resolver.cjs` from the reviewed checkout: POSIX resume launch exits 0; probe-shaped execution fails with `spawn ~/bin/claude ENOENT`. PowerShell planning produces probe binary `&`. Output: `/tmp/xmr-probe-review-repro.resolver.out`.
- Unverified: Windows runtime behavior; the Windows parser and generated launch command were checked on macOS.
- Unverified: `tests/e2e/cross-machine-recovery-two-profile.spec.ts` was source-reviewed but not executed. This session requires browser automation through `agent-browser`; the existing runner launches Electron through Playwright.

No source changes. The reviewed worktree remains clean at the requested commit.
